author: homelab
name: Cryptominer execution
description: Port of Wazuh 100103: miner names in host syslog/auth lines (Wazuh negate list kept) or in an osquery running_processes command line.
query: (message:(xmrig or monero or cpuminer or nbminer or "t-rex" or ethminer or phoenixminer or lolminer or teamredminer or nicehash or minexmr or "stratum+tcp") and not message:(unbound or monerod or mullvad or protonvpn or nordvpn)) or (osquery.name:running_processes and osquery.action:added and osquery.columns.cmdline:(*xmrig* or *cpuminer* or *nbminer* or *ethminer* or *phoenixminer* or *lolminer* or *teamredminer* or *nicehash* or *stratum+tcp*))
